name: The refresh token was spent outside the browser: the application offers to sign in again instead of stopping quietly
description: The test takes the refresh token the application keeps in the browser and uses it once itself, without touching the application at all. With "Revoke Refresh Token" in the realm that spends the token, so the renewal of the application is a second use of the same one: the provider ends the session, and the user must be offered to sign in again rather than left with an application that has quietly stopped working. Nothing in the application is switched off to provoke it.
